reason: A Windows Electron desktop client that embeds the DeepSeek Harness web UI and automates environment setup, local service startup, plugin installation, GitHub-based plugin discovery, settings, and application updates.

summaries.zh: 一个面向 Windows 的 Electron 桌面客户端，用于嵌入 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 并管理环境安装、本地服务启动、插件安装和应用更新。
summaries.en: A Windows Electron desktop client for embedding the DeepSeek Harness Web UI and managing environment setup, local service startup, plugin installation, and application updates.

capabilities: Embeds and launches the DeepSeek Harness web UI in an Electron desktop application
Detects the local environment and installs Node.js-related dependencies and packages
Starts, stops, restarts, and manages local service processes
Installs and uninstalls npm-based plugins, including user-supplied install commands
Scans public GitHub repositories through the GitHub API to discover plugins
Downloads and installs application updates with SHA256 verification
Displays startup, installation, build, and command-line logs
